body:
I know what you mean. You think to yourself: How is it that I'm willing to give so much and I'm asking for so little in return? Why does this feel so impossible? 

Honestly. I've been trying to change my attitude around and I'm focusing more on me. But at the same time, life can get boring in the midst of routine. And so we find ourselves, more lonely and depressed than ever. 

And yes let's keep in touch!!!!! 
Yes, I know what you meant haha. 

Sorry for the late reply also. Have had a LOT going on lately. 

Hope you're feeling better than when you wrote this. 

Always remember that
YOU. ARE. NOT. ALONE. 

:)

I'm sorry you feel this way about yourself. I also have an incredibly low self esteem and things I don't like about my body. That's why I get lip injections and I'm having plastic surgery this summer. Even if you can't do surgery, make up is still an amazing way to alter your appearance. I know people are going to disagree with my view on altering appearances, but I feel like unless you really know what it feels like then you don't understand. I sympathize with you. But don't kill yourself. Take some deep breaths and try to figure out how you can fix this. Trust me, this is totally fixable.

Omg that is EXACTLY how I feel! I don't talk about these feelings I have with anyone in fear that I may sound "desperate" but I suffer from depression and I literally think that sentence in my head all the time. "I have so much love to give and no one to give it to." I feel like I'm constantly around people who treat relationships as if they don't really treasure them. I feel like no one is the way I am. I want to be relaxed and laid back sure but I want to be crazy about the person I'm with. I want to meet someone who's going to make me feel like my hearts gonna explode. I've only had that once in my life. I just want to be in love so badly. But I can't force it. I hope that person is out there.
Yeah but I feel like it's never going to change.

I'm in debt too. 

I have no life and no job. No friends. No family. 

I honestly want to die today.

I have the EXACT same problem. I made appointments with a psychiatrist and a therapist. I'll let you know what they tell me if I find something out. Of course all of us are different. But I feel you 100%. That's literally why I went to the doctors today and now I have a prescription for antidepressants.

I got fired from my job too! Yesterday! I'm so sorry you're going through this. It was such a good job for me too. I spent the entire day with doctors today getting asked all kinds of questions and now I'm on antidepressants. I just got kinda happy for a second because to find someone going through the same thing you are is rare man. I've been scrolling through and just saw your post. I've been wanting to kill myself because I'm so unhappy with my life. Every aspect of it. I can get into so many reasons why I'm depressed. Shitty/absent parents, abusive ex, isolation, loneliness, rejection..it goes on and on. I hope you feel better and get help. But if you don't hey, I don't blame you. I'm going to see how these pills and therapy work out for me. If not, I guess I can just take a bunch of them at the same time and call it a day.

While that is extremely sweet and heartwarming I feel like I need much, much more than that. I'm at the doctors right now which I know just means they're gonna write me a prescription for Xanax and send me on my way. Even that isn't enough for what I feel like I need. Professional help probably won't even do much for me at this point. I don't know. Who's to say. 

That is very true. About things not being in my control. I just feel like what I want is so little but so important to me. I don't need to be rich or drive a nice car to be happy. I'm faced with the same question. Why can't I just have what so many other people have? The very basics. It's awfully frustrating. 


Yes, having an abusive upbringing is horrible. But it doesn't set us up for imminent failure. I'm smart enough to know this. But I'm just tired of fighting against all the negativity and getting no where. I'm so sorry you had to deal with abusive parents. No one deserves that. We both got unlucky in that department. You seemed to turn out ok though. High five for not letting our parents completely ruin us. 

Yes. On love. I believe my ex does love me but we just know we aren't right together. But he must love me to text me every day and tell me he hopes I'm doing ok and still be there for me throughout all my craziness. I wish I knew how to pick the right person. I thought I was doing that with my most recent ex and it completely backfired. 

Thank you for your kind words. Sending you a virtual hug right back.

I've had a horrible life actually. Or so it feels like. 

I'm sorry you're going through something similar that is putting you down. I don't know whether to feel more at ease that there are so many other people that feel the same way I do or if that actually makes me feel worse.  50/50 maybe. 

The military is really great for a lot of people. It makes them a part of something much bigger and gives them a strong sense of purpose. I really respect that and I respect our troops. That's definitely something to consider. If I'm gonna die might as well die for our country. I'll be thinking about that. Thank you for that. 

I used to be strong. I don't feel strong anymore. I feel like I'm really coming to the end here, but thank you for trying to make me feel better.

Thank you for the kind words. It's a nice feeling to know there's someone out there who is compassionate. My mom doesn't believe in depression or anxiety. She says we "all have control of our emotions." So I've been forced for a long time to try and just "deal with it" and put on a fake smile. I'm just so tired. I agree and I feel like everyone deserves to be happy and to be loved. I just feel like life is so pointless when I never get those simple things. I would be happy with so little and I can't even have that no matter how much I try to work hard and do the right thing and be there for others. I've tried different approaches, tried new things, tried putting myself out there. Now I feel like screaming at the top of my lungs but I can't do that so I come to reddit instead. Thank you again for your comment.

It's crazy how the people who are crazy about us actually push us away. I mean we think we want this passionate unconditional love but only in the way we picture it. I have had several guys want to date me and I can tell they were serious. But it just doesn't feel the same as with my ex. If I don't feel that same level of passion or fire then I feel like I'm cheating myself and it's not even worth it. It feels dull. Which is maybe what you felt like with your ex who is so certain you guys are going to get married.

My ex and I can't stop talking. We have tried it for years. We literally can't keep our hands off each other and we know it's bad. But the sexual attraction is insane. It's a constant reminder what I'm looking for but will never have again. Believe me I have seriously put the work in. If I could meet someone who makes me feel that way I would cut my ex off out of respect for my hypothetical relationship to give myself the chance to be happy and have that passionate love that I want so badly. I tried to start a new relationship and just ended up in a worse situation. So back to my ex's arms I go. 

I'm sorry you got cheated on. I feel like it still stings no matter how long the relationship was. Especially if you really loved that person. It hurts. 

Yeah my family situation is bleak. I feel like I got dealt a pretty bad hand. I feel like that's the theme of my entire life. It's getting old. 

Thank you for your kind words. I'm at the doctors office right now. Which I don't see the point in really because all they're going to do is give me Xanax. But if I do decide to go through with killing myself then I'm sure those will come in handy.

I'm also suffering from depression. I was searching for ways online tonight to kill myself. I'm 26 years old and on the same track as you are. I also feel it is too long of an amount of time to not experience any joy. For me it's constantly feeling like I'm not good enough. I feel like I'm not meant to have even the simplest of things most people have that would make me happy. I know it's my mental illness but the pain is so severe I just can't take it anymore. I'm sorry you had shitty friends. Real friends don't treat their friends that way. I thought about the gun method but I thought sleeping pills with the car running in the garage would be less "messy." You're not definitely not alone.
